run_pooling_api_completions: run the pooling API with a completions-style prompt to get embeddings for a text input
run_pooling_api_chat: run the pooling API with a chat-style prompt containing user messages and text content
post_http_request_pooling: post an HTTP request with a prompt dict to the vLLM pooling endpoint and return the response
parse_pooling_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for host and port to connect to a vLLM pooling server
run_pooling_example_main: run the main pooling example that lists models and sends completions and chat prompts to the pooling API
